findings.title: getCacheStatusByCredentialIds returns expired cache entries
findings.body: The `getCacheStatusByCredentialIds` method queries all `CalendarCache` rows for the given credential IDs without filtering by `expiresAt`. This means the UI will display a `cacheUpdatedAt` timestamp even for cache entries that have already expired, misleading users into thinking their cache is still active. The query should include `expiresAt: { gte: new Date() }` in the `where` clause to only return statuses for valid (non-expired) cache entries.

findings.title: deleteCache mutation does not invalidate connectedCalendars query
findings.body: After successfully deleting cache, the `deleteCacheMutation` calls `onSuccess?.()` but never invalidates the `trpc.viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars` query. The `disconnectMutation` correctly invalidates it in `onSettled`, but `deleteCacheMutation` does not. As a result, the UI will continue to display the stale `cacheUpdatedAt` timestamp until the user navigates away and returns or manually refreshes. An `onSettled` callback should be added to invalidate `utils.viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars`.

findings.title: Plain Error thrown instead of TRPCError results in generic 500 response
findings.body: When the credential is not found or access is denied, the handler throws a plain `Error('Credential not found or access denied')`. TRPC will wrap this as an INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR (500) with the message potentially hidden from the client depending on configuration. It should throw a `TRPCError` with code `NOT_FOUND` or `FORBIDDEN` so the client receives an appropriate error code and can handle it correctly.

findings.title: Hardcoded 'en-US' locale in date formatting ignores user's locale
findings.body: The `Intl.DateTimeFormat` is hardcoded to `"en-US"` locale. Since this is a user-facing component in an internationalized application (using `useLocale`), it should use the user's actual locale for date formatting. This will display dates in US format (e.g., 'MM/DD/YYYY') for all users regardless of their locale preference.

findings.title: Migration warning comment contradicts the actual SQL statement
findings.body: The auto-generated warning comment states 'Added the required column `updatedAt` to the `CalendarCache` table without a default value. This is not possible if the table is not empty.' However, the actual SQL on line 9 includes `DEFAULT NOW()`, which means it IS safe for non-empty tables. The misleading warning could cause unnecessary concern during migration review or cause someone to incorrectly believe the migration will fail on existing data.

findings.title: Authorization check only matches direct userId, missing team/shared credentials
findings.body: The credential lookup uses `userId: user.id` which only matches credentials directly owned by the user. In cal.com, credentials can be team-owned or delegated. A user with legitimate access to a team credential (e.g., through team membership or delegation) would receive 'Credential not found or access denied' when trying to clear its cache. If team credentials should be manageable by team members, the authorization check needs to account for team membership.
